# A table shows the rows it is handed after it is built, on every target.
#
# The rows are state the click fills in, so before it the table has headings
# and nothing under them, and after it two rows. Each target's two snapshots
# must differ, and those with text say why.
#
# fyne and android drew a table as an empty box and an empty Text, so their
# two snapshots were the same picture: fyne's is a grid of labels a column per
# heading, android's a Column of Rows of weighted cells. bubbletea built its
# bubbles table once from the rows it started with, none, and showed headings
# alone ever after; its table is handed them on each view and update, as a
# select's choices are. html wrote the rows' slot anchor, a span, into the
# table's tbody in its markup, which the parser moves out before the table,
# so the rows rendered above the headings; it writes a template there, which
# the parser keeps, and puts the span in its place at boot.
#
# panel.sngl is a table in a tab's panel. fyne builds the grid with its column
# count, which no setter changes, and refused a write of it that a pass had
# copied from the write the grid was built from, as if it were a new value.

mkdir none html bubbletea fyne gtk4 android
env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1

cp app.sngl none/app.sngl
sngl test --platform=none none/app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
cp panel.sngl none/panel.sngl
sngl test --platform=none none/panel.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
grep 'rows=\[\{cells = \["Ada", "Engineer"\]\}, \{cells = \["Grace", "Admiral"\]\}\]' none/app.sngl.snapshots/crewed.sngl
grep 'rows=\[\]' none/app.sngl.snapshots/empty.sngl

cp app.sngl html/app.sngl
sngl test --platform=html html/app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
cp panel.sngl html/panel.sngl
sngl test --platform=html html/panel.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
grep '(?s)<tbody[^>]*>\s*<span data-sngl-slot="0" style="display: contents;"><tr><td[^>]*>Ada</td><td[^>]*>Engineer</td></tr><tr><td[^>]*>Grace</td><td[^>]*>Admiral</td></tr></span>\s*</tbody>' html/app.sngl.snapshots/crewed.html
! grep '>Grace<' html/app.sngl.snapshots/empty.html

cp app.sngl bubbletea/app.sngl
sngl test --platform=bubbletea bubbletea/app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
cp panel.sngl bubbletea/panel.sngl
sngl test --platform=bubbletea bubbletea/panel.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
grep '(?s)Name .*Role .*Ada .*Engineer .*Grace .*Admiral' bubbletea/app.sngl.snapshots/crewed.ansi
! grep 'Grace' bubbletea/app.sngl.snapshots/empty.ansi

cp app.sngl fyne/app.sngl
sngl test --platform=fyne fyne/app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
cp panel.sngl fyne/panel.sngl
sngl test --platform=fyne fyne/panel.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
! cmp fyne/app.sngl.snapshots/empty.png fyne/app.sngl.snapshots/crewed.png

cp app.sngl gtk4/app.sngl
sngl test --platform=gtk4 gtk4/app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
cp panel.sngl gtk4/panel.sngl
sngl test --platform=gtk4 gtk4/panel.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
! cmp gtk4/app.sngl.snapshots/empty.png gtk4/app.sngl.snapshots/crewed.png

cp app.sngl android/app.sngl
sngl test --platform=android android/app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
cp panel.sngl android/panel.sngl
sngl test --platform=android android/panel.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
! cmp android/app.sngl.snapshots/robolectric/empty.png android/app.sngl.snapshots/robolectric/crewed.png

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import test "sngl:test"

component main ui.node {
    var crew list[list[string]] = []

    ui.vbox {
        ui.table(columns=["Name", "Role"]) {
            for var c = crew {
                ui.tableRow(cells=c)
            }
        }
        ui.button #hire(text="hire", @click { crew = [["Ada", "Engineer"], ["Grace", "Admiral"]] })
    }
}

func testRowsArrive(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.snapshot("empty")
    c.hire.click()
    t.snapshot("crewed")
}
-- panel.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import test "sngl:test"

component main ui.node {
    var crew list[list[string]] = []
    var tab = 0

    ui.button #hire(text="hire", @click { crew = [["Ada", "Engineer"]] })
    ui.tabs #tabs(:selected=tab) {
        ui.tab(label="One") {
            ui.text(value="one")
        }
        ui.tab(label="Crew") {
            ui.table #crewTable(columns=["Name", "Role"]) {
                for var r = crew {
                    ui.tableRow(cells=r)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

func testThePanelHoldsTheTable(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.hire.click()
    t.assert(c.crewTable == null)
    c.tabs.change(1)
    t.assert(c.crewTable != null)
}
